shots.name: 판매조회 Search(F3) 조건 판
steps: expect:(() => { const p = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.ec-search-panel')); return p.borderTopWidth === '1px' && p.borderTopLeftRadius === '20px' && p.borderBottomLeftRadius === '20px' && p.boxShadow !== 'none' })()

expect:(() => { const lis = [...document.querySelectorAll('.conds-open .ec-cond > li')]; const xs = new Set(lis.map((l) => Math.round(l.getBoundingClientRect().x))); const t = lis[0].querySelector('.title').getBoundingClientRect(); return xs.size === 1 && Math.round(t.width) === 114 && lis[0].querySelector('.title').textContent.trim() === '기준일자' })()

expect:(() => { const d = (n) => { const t = new Date(); t.setDate(t.getDate() + n); return t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') }; const v = [...document.querySelectorAll('.conds-open .ec-cond > li')][0].querySelectorAll('input[type=date]'); return v[0].value === d(-30) && v[1].value === d(30) })()
